featured_reviews.name: Waseem Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
In 2018, my mother was diagnosed with cancer, and we began her treatment at various hospitals in Pune. We went through everything—surgery, chemotherapy, and the many challenges that come with such a difficult journey. Unfortunately, in 2020, despite all our efforts, the cancer returned.
To make things even harder, 2020 was the peak of the COVID-19 pandemic. Visiting hospitals itself was extremely difficult due to restrictions, safety risks, and limited medical access. During this stressful time, my cousin introduced us to Dr. Fayyaz. From the very first meeting, he became a tremendous source of support and guidance.
He connected us with some of the best doctors in Asia at Lilavati Hospital, and despite his busy schedule, he always made time to guide us through each step of my mother's treatment. He recommended the right specialists, the best hospitals, and ensured that we received quality care within our budget. His help during COVID—especially when accessing medical care was so challenging—was truly a blessing.
Dr. Fayyaz has a heart of gold. His dedication, compassion, and sincere efforts made a world of difference to our family. I wholeheartedly wish him all the very best for the future.

I am a British citizen who has decided to under-go dental implants and cosmetic procedures, namely blepharoplasty and liposuction on neck, chest and stomach. Doctor Amogh was my coordinator at Indmed. featured_reviews.name: ashok mukherjee
featured_reviews.review_text:
Happy experience...
Thanks doctors....

Yes my friends,
People write many nasty experience they face in hospital or with doctors. Very few write their sweet experiences in hospital or with doctors.

So I thought to share my excellent sweet experience with a small, faraway hospital but with exceptional expertise in the field of knee replacement and other orthopedic and neurological complication.

My wife Operated for knee replacement on 15th...At 11 in the morning (to 2.30 pm) including recovery time inside operation theatre...

Then shifted to ICU.
Operation was good, my wife was in jolly mood and smiling while coming out from OT after the replacement ... But after 2 hrs of shifting to ICU, the real pain started... Wife was crying like mad for pain... But through medication by 8 pm it has started reducing... and she slept.
Nxt day, 16th, morning no pain...and shifted to pvt room cabin. I also staying in the same room with her. Excellent clean cosy room with all necessary requirements like AC, TV, eye catching view from 4th floor Window, attached very clean bath (no balcony), clean and daily fresh linen.

17th.. Sr Doctors and physiotherapist started her to walk and bent the new knee to 90°...

This was regular exercise, bending knee to 90° and walking in the corridor with the help of walker and physiotherapist till 19th...

And on 19th all bandage and all drain-pipes ( 3 in total... For Blood to drain our excess blood at operated knee, one for urine, one at spinal joint to push different medicine ) removed and....
discharged in the afternoon by doctor...
Same day, 19th, came to home by evening.

She is recovering nicely.... Walking inside the flat with the help of walker... pain she feel very very rarely.

After 9th day from operation, today (24th March) was the first check up...and it is absolutely OK.
Infact, my wife walk through out the day in hospital alone with the help of walker.
Today, she has been allowed by doctor to move and do morning/evening walk with walker and asked for further check up after 15 days.
No medicine given except multivitamin for further recovery as she has no pain.

We are very very happy for the excellent smooth operation, expertise of doctors, quick recovery process with effective treatment, support of Jr. Doctors, Physiotherapist, Metron, Sisters, Brothers, room boy and aayas for 24×7 and overall management of the hospital.

Well behaved people....
No extra billing...

We, and no one, before surgery, expected that after operation on 2nd day pain would vanish... she would walk and bend knee to 90°and get discharge on 4th day...!!!

All credit goes to Dr. Rahul Bade and his team including Anesthesists Dr. Ganesh Kolhe at Sparsh Multi-Speciality Hospital.

Thank you...well done, doctor !!!
🙏🙏🙏

Thanks to Lt. Col Dr Amogh Yadav from Mumbai and Dr. Rahul Mane for strongly recomanding us the hospital.

(Note : Treatment was going on at Sanchiti Hospital. But operated at Sparsh Multi Speciality Hospital)

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Telure
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am incredibly grateful to Dr. Vijay Bang for the outstanding care and treatment he provided to my mother. After her initial angiography in Nashik was unsuccessful, we were highly anxious and seeking expert guidance. Dr. Vijay Bang meticulously performed a re-angiogram and utilized an FFR (Fractional Flow Reserve) test to assess the exact nature of the blockage. His precise diagnosis revealed that the blockage was only 30-40%, saving her from unnecessary invasive procedures.

​Later, when my mother had to be readmitted due to a critically high CRP (C-Reactive Protein) count, Dr. Bang immediately identified the issue, put her on the right medication, and successfully brought the levels down. Dr. Vijay Bang is not just an exceptionally skilled interventional cardiologist, but also a deeply compassionate professional. The world-class care at Lilavati Hospital, combined with his expertise, gave our family immense peace of mind. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text:
Exceptional service from start to finish. I had tight time constraints arriving from abroad on a last-minute booking, and the team at NM Medical Khar went above and beyond to accommodate me. They fast-tracked my Platinum health checkup and ensured everything ran as smoothly as possible given the circumstances.

Special mention to Anu, who was outstanding. She guided me seamlessly from one test to the next, making what can otherwise be a fragmented and confusing process feel completely effortless. Her warmth, organisation and attention to detail made a real difference.

When I requested my reports be delivered to my hotel at Taj Santacruz, they arranged it without any fuss — a much appreciated touch.

One useful tip for anyone planning a visit: some tests are linked to the morning shift, so if you can, arrive early to get the full benefit of your package. This was entirely down to my own last-minute planning and late arrival — not a reflection of the team’s service, which was five star throughout.
Highly recommend NM Medical Khar without hesitation.

The staff was courteous, helpful, and guided me properly at every step, which made the experience stress-free. All tests were conducted efficiently without unnecessary delays.

featured_reviews.name: Jayesh Rao
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Team,

I am writing to express my extreme disappointment regarding the cancellation of my shoulder sonography appointment, which was informed to me merely 45 minutes before the scheduled time.

The reason provided was that the doctor was attending an emergency and would not be available for the entire day. This raises a serious concern — what kind of emergency lasts for the entire day without any backup arrangement being available in a reputed medical centre like yours?

What is even more frustrating is that the only alternative offered to us was an appointment on Monday instead of Saturday. We are working individuals and had managed, with great difficulty, to arrange leave from work specifically for this appointment. Because of your inability to honour the commitment given to patients, we are now forced to take another leave on a working Monday as well.

Additionally, we were informed that there is only one doctor available for sonography. Is this truly the strength of your medical network and operational preparedness? For a healthcare institution of your scale, this reflects extremely poor planning and lack of contingency management.

Due to this last-minute cancellation, we are now unable to secure appointments elsewhere for today, causing unnecessary inconvenience, stress, and delay in medical evaluation.

Such unprofessional handling of patient appointments is highly unacceptable in the medical field, where discipline, responsibility, and patient commitment should be treated with utmost importance.

I sincerely hope you take this complaint seriously and ensure that such incidents are not repeated with other patients in the future.

Regards,
Jayesh Rao

featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable experience. I am bruised, in pain, and honestly shocked at how careless and unprofessional this entire blood collection process was.

The technician moved the needle around INSIDE my vein multiple times after inserting it causing severe pain through my hand and arm. My whole hand has been hurting since. I already had a visible bruise from previous blood tests and specifically told him to use the same vein but a different spot, yet he still pierced directly through the bruised area.

What made this even worse was the complete lack of basic hygiene and professionalism. He was going to draw my blood without alcohol swabs and gloves until I pointed it out, which is beyond unacceptable for a basic medical procedure. On top of that, he casually threw the vials into a bag instead of storing and handling them properly, making me seriously question the safety and integrity of the samples.

To end it all, he then tried to overcharge me. After paying 13,000, he said if you don’t pay me more I won’t send you the link to your results.

Would strongly advise people to NOT book with NM MEDICAL

Similarly, she got me the best treatment for Bell's palsy - immediately as I woke up with a paralysed face. She has saved my life several times over from diseases or illnesses that are out of syllabus for a Gynaecologist. But Dr Bindu is at another level! She is the best doctor, a great surgeon ( I have no scars from my C section) and if she does not know the cure, she will recommend you to the best doctor promptly.
